summary: Titan America SA filed a Form 6-K announcing a $0.04 per share distribution from issue premium for Q3 2026, payable October 9, 2026, to shareholders of record October 1, 2026. This is a routine quarterly distribution, not a special situation such as a capital return event. The board retains discretion over future distributions based on available premium, earnings, and cash needs. No transaction, activist campaign, restructuring, or other special situation is present. The filing is a standard periodic report of a foreign private issuer regarding a declared distribution, thus no further analysis is warranted.
